description.fun: Throh is a judo master: whenever it meets a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. Throh train in groups of five, and any member that can't keep up throws away its belt and leaves. Wild Throh weave their own black belts from vines, and over many battles the belt darkens with sweat. Ken Sugimori designed it and its karate rival Sawk; early sketches of both had horns, perhaps from oni.
description.guide: Throh is a Fighting-type Pokémon modelled on a judo practitioner, always male, that tries to throw opponents larger than itself. It trains in groups of five and grows stronger when it tightens its belt. It is the counterpart of Sawk and does not evolve.
description.tagline: A judo thrower that weaves its own black belt.
